crossRefs.note: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
Happy are your men, happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to…
Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
